subject: Request for promotional eval credits + trial extension — Nimbus Health bake-off

From: Alan Baker <alan.baker@nimbus.health>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 28 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: additional eval credits for Nimbus bake-off

Marcus —

Appreciate the demo last week. We're running a tight, vendor-neutral bake-off (Redwood, PeakAI, and two others) against our production clinical summarization pipeline. Our evaluation needs to run full-length transcripts and synthetic worst-case prompts; the estimate is ~200k tokens and we need the test window extended by ~30–45 days to get legal/procurement sign-off.

Before we loop procurement, is there flexibility on promotional credits and a longer trial period for this RFP? If Redwood can provide a credit pool and a 30–45 day extension we can guarantee test parity and include your results in the final short-list.

We can share our evaluation rubric and sample transcripts; happy to sign a standard promotional terms addendum.

Thanks —
Alan Baker
Program Manager, AI Ops
Nimbus Health
Phone: +1 415 555 0192
Attachment: evaluation_rubric_v2.csv (CSV, 18 KB)

Date: Wed, 28 Jul 2027 10:04:00 -07:00

Alan —

Thanks for the note and for sharing the rubric — that helps a lot. I can escalate a promotional credit and trial extension request, but I need to confirm approvals and the maximum cap we can offer for an RFP. Can you confirm whether the evaluation will be public (benchmarks shared) or private between teams? Also: is there a stated PO timeline if we provide credits?

I'll ping my manager and billing to get a quick decision — will follow up today.

Marissa / Dylan —

Forwarding Nimbus's ask: they need roughly ~200k tokens worth of eval and a 30–45 day extension window to complete procurement. They will include Redwood on a short-list if we can meet parity with PeakAI. HubSpot deal link: https://hubspot.redwood.example/deal/DEAL-3497

Proposed quick option: offer a capped promotional credit of 120k tokens + 30-day trial extension, subject to signed promo terms. Alternative: 150k tokens if we can get a verbal commitment or LOI quickly. Please advise who signs off and whether billing/legal will accept the standard promo addendum (attached draft).

Marcus —

I can approve promo credits for competitive bake-offs, with a couple of constraints:
- Cap at 120k tokens (marketing/CS will track usage)
- 30-day extension as default; the extra 15 days only if procurement provides an executed PO within the 30-day window
- Promo addendum must include an explicit non-comparative benchmark clause (no public scorecards without our written permission)

If billing/legal confirm the standard addendum is acceptable, go ahead and offer 120k tokens + 30 days. If Nimbus insists on 45 days up front, we need a PO/LOI before granting it.

Marissa
VP, North America Sales | Redwood Inference

Good news: we can offer a promotional package to support the bake-off. Summary: 120,000 tokens of evaluation credit + a 30-day trial extension. Thanks —
